notes: SEQN is the unique respondent identifier. It maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.

Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight. It can be stored as an observation with a custom concept for survey weights, or in a derived table. No standard concept_id exists for NHANES weights.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight. Similar to WTDRD1, stored as an observation with a custom concept.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall. Stored as an observation to preserve the sequence.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating reliability/completeness. Requires a custom concept; no standard OMOP concept exists for NHANES dietary recall status.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as an observation string; could also be linked to provider table if interviewers are considered providers.
Breast-fed infant indicator. OMOP concept_id 45878386 represents 'Breastfeeding status' and can be used with appropriate value concepts (e.g., Yes/No).
Number of days of intake is a categorical variable (e.g., 1 day, 2 days). Requires a custom concept; no standard OMOP concept exists.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous variable. Stored as an observation with a custom concept for time intervals.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable. Could map to OMOP day of week concepts if available, but likely requires a custom concept.
Language respondent used mostly. OMOP has language concepts (e.g., 4182343 for Spanish), but specific mapping depends on NHANES codes. Use value_as_concept_id with appropriate language concept.
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination foods. Stored as an observation to preserve the sequence.
Combination food type is a categorical/text variable describing the type of combination food. Stored as observation string; could be mapped to custom concepts.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM). Can be stored as a time or datetime in observation, combined with the recall date. No standard concept for eating occasion time.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch). OMOP has meal concepts (e.g., 44803970 for Breakfast), but mapping depends on NHANES codes. Use value_as_concept_id with appropriate meal concept.

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where food was obtained. It maps to observation value_as_concept_id using a custom concept or source value mapping. No single standard concept covers all NHANES source categories.
Binary question 'Did you eat this meal at home?' maps to observation. Standard concept 4188539 (Yes/No) or similar binary response concept can be used for value_as_concept_id.

USDA food code is an identifier for the food item. It can be stored as value_source_value in observation, with observation_source_value indicating the variable. No direct OMOP standard concept for USDA food codes.
Modification code indicates type of modification to food (e.g., fortified, reduced fat). Maps to observation value_as_concept_id with custom concepts for each modification type.

Grams of food consumed is a continuous measurement. Maps to measurement table with concept_id for 'Mass' (e.g., 0 as placeholder; actual concept for mass unit may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.
Energy in kcal is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Energy' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for energy intake may be used). Unit concept for kcal is 8713.
Protein in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Protein' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for protein intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Carbohydrate in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Carbohydrate' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for carbohydrate intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Total sugars in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Sugars, total' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for sugar intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Dietary fiber in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Fiber, total dietary' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for fiber intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Total fat in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Fat, total' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for total fat intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Saturated fatty acids in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Fatty acids, total saturated' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for saturated fat intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Fatty acids, total monounsaturated' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for monounsaturated fat intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Fatty acids, total polyunsaturated' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for polyunsaturated fat intake may be used). Unit concept for gram is 8587.

Cholesterol in mg is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement with concept for 'Cholesterol' (e.g., 0 placeholder; standard concept for cholesterol intake may be used). Unit concept for mg is 8576.
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol intake in mg. Maps to measurement of alpha-tocopherol.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) in mg. No standard concept for added alpha-tocopherol; use measurement with value_as_number.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of retinol.
Vitamin A, RAE intake in mcg. Maps to measurement of vitamin A.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. No standard concept; use measurement with value_as_number.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. No standard concept; use measurement with value_as_number.

Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to measurement of vitamin B6.
